guide.title: What BMI measures
paragraphs: BMI is weight in kilograms divided by height in metres squared. It is a practical screening measure for weight status, not a direct measurement of body fat.
For adults, common reference categories place 18.5–24.9 in the healthy-weight range, 25.0–29.9 in the overweight range, and 30 or above in the obesity range.

guide.title: Why the number needs context
paragraphs: BMI can be less representative in people with high muscle mass. Abdominal fat also matters, so waist measurement can add useful context.
Some guidelines use lower BMI thresholds for certain populations because cardiometabolic risk can occur at lower BMI.

guide.title: What to check next
paragraphs: For adults with BMI below 35, waist-to-height ratio can be used alongside BMI as a practical estimate of central adiposity. A simple reference is a waist below half of height.
Blood pressure, blood glucose, blood lipids, physical activity and weight trend can also put the number in context.

guide.title: Important limitations
paragraphs: Children and teenagers need age- and sex-specific growth references. Pregnancy has separate weight-gain guidance. Older adults and people with high muscle mass may need additional context when BMI is interpreted.

sources: NICE – Overweight, obesity and central adiposity

zh.screening: BMI 是筛查指标，不是疾病诊断，也不能直接测出体脂含量。
zh.weightRange: 按 BMI 计算的参考体重范围
zh.rangeNote: 这是参考范围，不是针对个人设定的目标体重。
zh.waistLow: 低于 0.40：低于常用参考区间，建议结合其他指标理解。
zh.waistHealthy: 0.40–0.49：较健康的中心性脂肪参考范围。
zh.waistIncreased: 0.50–0.59：中心性脂肪堆积增加的参考范围。
zh.waistHigh: ≥0.60：中心性脂肪堆积较高的参考范围。
zh.waistLessUseful: BMI 达到 35 或以上时，腰围身高比对风险区分的参考价值会下降。
zh.chinaWaist: 中国中心型肥胖筛查：男性腰围 ≥90 厘米、女性 ≥85 厘米。
zh.riskChecks: 还可以关注腰围、血压、血糖、血脂、日常活动量，以及体重随时间的变化趋势。
zh.muscle: 肌肉量较高的人可能因为肌肉多而 BMI 偏高，所以 BMI 不能单独判断体脂多少。
zh.older: 老年人解读 BMI 时，还应结合年龄、基础疾病和功能状态。
zh.pregnancy: BMI 不是孕期体重增长评估工具。
zh.children: 儿童和青少年需要按年龄、性别使用相应的生长曲线，不能直接套用成人分类。
zh.notDiagnosis: 单独一个 BMI 数值不能判断一个人是否健康。
zh.ethnic: 一些指南针对部分人群使用更低的 BMI 风险阈值，因为代谢风险可能在更低 BMI 时出现。应按所在地区或所采用指南理解结果。
zh.ageWarning: 此工具用于成人。如果年龄小于 18 岁，应使用儿童或青少年按年龄和性别划分的 BMI 参考。

guide.title: BMI 是什么？
paragraphs: BMI = 体重（公斤）÷ 身高（米）²。它是一个用于筛查体重状态的简单指标，但不能直接测量体脂，也不能单独判断一个人是否健康。
通用成人参考通常把 18.5–24.9 作为参考正常范围、25.0–29.9 作为超重、30 及以上作为肥胖。

guide.title: 为什么不能只看一个 BMI？
paragraphs: 肌肉量较高的人可能因为肌肉多而 BMI 偏高；腹部脂肪也很重要，所以腰围可以提供额外信息。
一些指南针对部分人群使用更低的 BMI 阈值，因为代谢风险可能在更低 BMI 时出现。

guide.title: 接下来可以关注什么？
paragraphs: 对于 BMI 低于 35 的成人，腰围身高比可以与 BMI 一起作为中心性脂肪堆积的实用参考。一个简单的参考是腰围低于身高的一半。
血压、血糖、血脂、日常活动量和体重变化趋势，也能帮助理解这个数字。

guide.title: 需要注意
paragraphs: 儿童和青少年需要按年龄和性别使用生长曲线；孕期有单独的体重增长标准。对于老年人和肌肉量较高的人，也需要结合更多背景信息理解 BMI。

sources: 美国 CDC：成人 BMI 分类
世界卫生组织：肥胖与超重
NICE：超重、肥胖与中心性肥胖评估
中国国家卫生健康委：《体重管理指导原则（2024年版）》

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: This calculator returns completed age in years from the birth date. It does not determine legal age, eligibility or any age-based rule.

guide.title: Important note
paragraphs: The result depends on the current date and the birth date entered.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 这个工具根据出生日期计算已经满了多少周岁。它不是法律年龄、资格条件或其他年龄规则的判断器。

guide.title: 注意
paragraphs: 结果取决于你输入的出生日期以及今天的日期。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: The result is an estimate based on the public exchange-rate data returned by the external rate service. It is not a guaranteed bank, card or cash-exchange rate.

guide.title: Before using the number
paragraphs: Exchange rates change. Fees, spreads and provider-specific rates can make the amount you actually receive different.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 结果是根据外部汇率服务返回的公开汇率计算出的估算值，不等于银行、信用卡或现金兑换时的最终成交汇率。

guide.title: 实际使用前注意
paragraphs: 汇率会变化，银行点差、手续费和不同服务商的报价，都可能让最终到账金额不同。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: The tool treats the entered date and time as a wall-clock time in the selected source time zone, then converts that instant to the target zone.

guide.title: Important note
paragraphs: Some local times around daylight-saving transitions can be ambiguous or skipped. The result should be checked for important appointments.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 工具会把你输入的日期和时间理解为“来源时区当地时间”，先确定对应的时间点，再换算到目标时区。

guide.title: 注意
paragraphs: 夏令时切换附近可能出现重复或不存在的当地时间。重要会议、航班和预约应再次核对。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: The result converts a value within one physical dimension. The tool now separates length, mass and time so unrelated units are not mixed.

guide.title: Important note
paragraphs: Unit symbols can vary by industry. Check the unit label before copying the result into a document or calculation.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 结果是在同一物理维度内换算后的数值。现在工具把长度、质量和时间分开，避免出现“米换公斤”这类没有意义的换算。

guide.title: 注意
paragraphs: 不同领域的单位写法可能不同，把结果用于正式文件或计算前应确认单位名称。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: The percentage change compares the new value with the original value. Positive means the new value is higher; negative means it is lower.

guide.title: Important note
paragraphs: When the original value is zero, percentage change is undefined. Negative starting values can also require additional context.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 百分比变化表示新数值相对于原数值变化了多少。正数表示增加，负数表示减少。

guide.title: 注意
paragraphs: 原数值为 0 时，百分比变化没有定义。原数值为负时，数学结果也需要结合具体业务背景理解。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: The result is the calendar date after adding or subtracting the specified number of days.

guide.title: Important note
paragraphs: This is a calendar-day calculation. It does not exclude weekends or public holidays.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 结果是在指定日期基础上增加或减少若干自然日后的日期。

guide.title: 注意
paragraphs: 这是自然日计算，不会自动排除周末或法定节假日。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: Profit margin is profit divided by revenue. It shows the portion of revenue left as profit under the costs you entered.

guide.title: Do not confuse it with markup
paragraphs: Markup uses cost as the denominator, while margin uses selling price or revenue as the denominator.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 利润率 = 利润 ÷ 收入，表示按你输入的成本口径，收入中有多少最终成为利润。

guide.title: 不要和加价率混淆
paragraphs: 加价率的分母是成本，利润率的分母是销售价格或收入，两者数值可以差很多。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: The result expresses the same mass in another unit, such as kilograms, pounds or ounces.

guide.title: Important note
paragraphs: Mass and weight are often used interchangeably in everyday language, but they are not identical physical concepts.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 结果表示同一质量用另一种单位表达，例如公斤、磅或盎司。

guide.title: 注意
paragraphs: 日常语言常把“质量”和“重量”混用，但在物理概念上并不是完全相同的量。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: The result is the equivalent temperature on the selected scale, such as Celsius, Fahrenheit or Kelvin.

guide.title: Important note
paragraphs: Temperature conversion changes the numerical scale; it does not change the physical state or actual heat content of an object.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 结果是同一个温度在摄氏、华氏或开尔文等不同温标下的对应数值。

guide.title: 注意
paragraphs: 换算只是改变温标的表达方式，并不意味着物体实际状态或热量发生变化。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: Aspect ratio is the simplified proportion of width to height, such as 16:9. It describes shape rather than resolution.

guide.title: Use it for
paragraphs: You can use the ratio to keep the same proportions when resizing an image or video frame.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 宽高比是宽度与高度的最简比例，例如 16:9。它描述的是形状比例，不是分辨率。

guide.title: 什么时候有用？
paragraphs: 调整图片或视频尺寸时，可以用它保持原来的画面比例，避免拉伸变形。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: The result is the calculated percentage amount. It is not the same thing as percentage change, which compares an old and new value.

guide.title: Example
paragraphs: 18% of 500 is 90. The 18% is the rate; 90 is the calculated amount.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 结果是算出来的百分比金额，不等于“百分比变化”。百分比变化需要比较原数值和新数值。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: Monthly payment is the scheduled payment for the entered principal, annual rate and term. Total interest adds up the interest over the full schedule.

guide.title: Assumptions and limitations
paragraphs: This calculator assumes a fixed annual rate and equal monthly payments. It does not include lender fees, insurance, taxes, penalties or rate changes.

guide.title: What to compare
paragraphs: A lower monthly payment can come from a longer term. Compare total repayment and total interest as well as the monthly payment.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 月供是根据本金、年利率和期限计算出的每月还款额；总利息是整个还款期累计的利息。

guide.title: 计算前提与限制
paragraphs: 当前工具按固定年利率、等额月供计算，不包括贷款手续费、保险、税费、罚金和利率变化。

guide.title: 实际比较什么？
paragraphs: 月供更低有时只是因为期限更长。比较贷款时，要同时看总还款额和总利息，不能只看月供。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: The result tells you the bill total after the selected tip rate and the amount per person when split.

guide.title: Important note
paragraphs: Tip customs differ by country, venue and service type. The calculator does not decide what percentage you should tip.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 结果表示按所选小费比例计算后的总额，以及多人平摊时每个人需要支付的金额。

guide.title: 注意
paragraphs: 不同国家、地区、餐厅和服务类型的小费习惯不同。本工具只负责计算，不判断应该给多少小费。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: Final price is the price after the entered discount. Saved is the amount removed from the original price.

guide.title: Check the real cost
paragraphs: Taxes, shipping, membership requirements and other fees may change the final amount you actually pay.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 最终价格是原价扣除折扣后的金额，“节省”是实际减掉的钱。

guide.title: 再看实际付款
paragraphs: 税费、运费、会员条件和其他费用可能让最终付款金额与折后价不同。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: Add VAT turns a net amount into a gross, tax-inclusive amount. Extract VAT separates the VAT portion from a gross amount.

guide.title: Important note
paragraphs: VAT rates and rules vary by jurisdiction and product. Enter the rate that actually applies to the transaction.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: “加上增值税”把未税金额换算成含税总额；“从含税价反算”则从含税金额中拆出税额和未税金额。

guide.title: 注意
paragraphs: 不同国家、地区和商品的税率及规则不同，应输入这笔交易实际适用的税率。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: Future value is the amount produced by the entered starting principal, annual rate and years under the calculator’s annual-compounding model.

guide.title: What is missing
paragraphs: Regular deposits, withdrawals, taxes, fees and changing rates are not modeled here, so the result is a simplified estimate.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 未来价值是在输入本金、年利率和年限下，按本工具的按年复利模型计算得到的终值。

guide.title: 当前没有计算什么？
paragraphs: 定期追加、提取、税费、手续费和利率变化没有纳入模型，因此这是一个简化估算。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: ROI is net gain divided by investment cost. A positive result means the received value is above the entered cost; a negative result means it is below.

guide.title: Important note
paragraphs: ROI does not tell you how long the investment took or how much risk was involved. Taxes and cash-flow timing can also matter.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: ROI = 净收益 ÷ 投资成本。正数表示回报高于投入，负数表示回报低于投入。

guide.title: 注意
paragraphs: ROI 本身没有反映投资用了多久、风险多大、税费多少以及现金流发生的时间。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: Markup is profit as a percentage of cost. It is different from profit margin, which uses selling price or revenue as the denominator.

guide.title: Example
paragraphs: Cost 60 and selling price 100 gives 66.67% markup but 40% profit margin.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 加价率 = 利润 ÷ 成本，不等于利润率。利润率的分母是销售价格或收入。

guide.title: 举个例子
paragraphs: 成本 60、售价 100 时，加价率是 66.67%，但利润率是 40%。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: Break-even units are the number of units needed for contribution from sales to cover fixed costs. The model reaches zero operating profit at that point.

guide.title: Assumptions
paragraphs: It assumes a constant selling price and variable cost per unit and does not model taxes, discounts, capacity limits or multiple products.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 盈亏平衡销量是用每件产品的贡献去覆盖固定成本所需要的销量。到达这个点时，模型中的经营利润正好为 0。

guide.title: 计算前提
paragraphs: 模型假设售价和单位可变成本保持不变，不考虑税费、折扣、产能限制或多产品组合。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: The result counts weekdays between the two dates and excludes Saturday and Sunday.

guide.title: Important note
paragraphs: Public holidays are not removed automatically. For payroll, contracts or country-specific work calendars, use the relevant holiday calendar too.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 结果按周一至周五统计两个日期之间的工作日，不计算周六和周日。

guide.title: 注意
paragraphs: 当前不会自动排除法定节假日。用于工资、合同或特定国家工作日安排时，还要结合当地节假日表。

guide.title: What the result means
paragraphs: The result is the absolute number of calendar days between the two dates. It is not a business-day count.

guide.title: Important note
paragraphs: Whether the first and last date should both be counted depends on the task. This tool uses the difference between dates rather than inclusive counting.

guide.title: 结果是什么意思？
paragraphs: 结果是两个日期之间相差的自然日天数，不是工作日数量。

guide.title: 注意
paragraphs: 有些场景需要把起始日和结束日都算进去，而当前工具计算的是两个日期之间的日期差。
